To our knowledge, no earlier complete solution has been identified; the literature search was independently reviewed on 16 September 2026. The Ree and Suzuki structure, matrix constructions, and twin-vertex principle are established mathematics and are credited to their sources.
bounded_conclusion: No earlier complete solution or credible unresolved exact-solution claim was identified in this targeted publication-time refresh together with the preserved 16 September dossier. No absolute priority is certified.

mathematical_overlap_assessment.kind: Reviewer inference from actual definitions and proof steps
mathematical_overlap_assessment.claim: Nonbinarity supplies a pairwise-compatible tuple map which need not extend to a relation-preserving permutation of the whole class. Arbitrary set extensions do not preserve relations on pairs involving the complement. A global map preserving every conjugation orbital would preserve all product-order colors, so nonbinarity alone is not the required color-breaking automorphism.
